# Agents Deck — vendor site

The three pages the plugin's Marketplace listing points at, and the browser client under `/app/`, served by GitHub Pages at
**<https://alenkazoloto.github.io/agents-deck>**:

| Page | Generated from |
|---|---|
| [`/`](https://alenkazoloto.github.io/agents-deck/) | `site/index.md` |
| [`/privacy`](https://alenkazoloto.github.io/agents-deck/privacy) | `PRIVACY.md` — the same file the plugin bundles for Settings › About |
| [`/eula`](https://alenkazoloto.github.io/agents-deck/eula) | `EULA.md` — likewise |
| [`/pair/`](https://alenkazoloto.github.io/agents-deck/pair/) | `site/pair-page.html` — where the pairing QR's link lands |
| [`/app/`](https://alenkazoloto.github.io/agents-deck/app/) | `site/app-src/` — the browser client, copied as written |
| [`/model-facts.json`](https://alenkazoloto.github.io/agents-deck/model-facts.json) | `site/model-facts.json` plus `pricing.json` — models released after a build |

Every `.html` outside `/app/` is generated. Editing it in this repository is a change that the next publish
overwrites; the sources live in the plugin repository beside the code they describe.
